title: Michael in a capsule with floating objects, bumping into Mario on a table
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was in another empty space or capsule or something and I saw things that was flying around, floating around rather

plain: A former Air Force man named Michael Johnson says that in 1977, near the missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he found himself in an empty space, "a capsule or something", where things were floating around him, and that he bumped into a fellow airman named Mario Woods lying on a table. Johnson tells it as his own experience aboard what he takes to be a craft, which would mean the two men were taken together.
